spec.description:
Robust Grafana dashboard for InfluxDB.

Leverages the _internal InfluxDB database to create the perfect snapshot of a variety of internal InfluxDB metrics.

spec.query: SELECT last("numSeries") FROM "monitor"."influxdb_database" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "host"
SELECT 100-last("usage_idle") FROM "monitor"."cpu" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(null)

SELECT difference(mean("queryDurationNs"))/difference(mean("queriesExecuted")) FROM "monitor"."influxdb_queryExecutor" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "host" fill(null)

spec.title: HTTP Request Duration (99th %)
spec.description: Displays the duration, in nanoseconds, of the top 1% of HTTP requests.

spec.query:
SELECT non_negative_derivative(percentile("writeReqDurationNs", 99)) / non_negative_derivative(max("writeReq")) AS "Write Request"
FROM "monitor"."influxdb_httpd" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "host" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(percentile("queryReqDurationNs", 99)) / non_negative_derivative(max("queryReq")) AS "Query Request"
FROM "monitor"."influxdb_httpd" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "host" fill(null)
SELECT last("diskBytes") FROM "monitor"."influxdb_tsm1_filestore" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "database", "host"

spec.title: Continuous Queries Executed / Minute
spec.description: Displays the non-negative mean rate of change in continuous queries (CQs) executed per minute.

spec.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("queryOk"), 1m) FROM "monitor"."cq" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval) fill(null)

spec.title: Shard Write Errors
spec.description: Displays the number of shard write errors.

spec.title: Series Cardinality by Database
spec.description: Displays the number of series (series cardinality) for the specified databases.

spec.query: SELECT last("numSeries") FROM "monitor"."database" WHERE ("hostname" = 'influx-data01.local') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "database", "hostname" fill(null)

spec.title: Number of Measurements by Database
spec.description: Displays the number of measurements, by database.

spec.query: SELECT mean("writeOk") FROM "monitor"."write" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("queryDurationNs"), $Interval)/non_negative_derivative(max("queriesExecuted"), $Interval) FROM "monitor"."influxdb_queryExecutor" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "host" fill(null)
SELECT max("queriesActive") FROM "monitor"."queryExecutor" WHERE ("hostname" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "hostname" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("queriesExecuted")) as "queriesExecuted" FROM "monitor"."queryExecutor"  WHERE ("hostname" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "hostname" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("queriesFinished")) as "queriesFinished" FROM "monitor"."queryExecutor"  WHERE ("hostname" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($Interval), "hostname" fill(null)

spec.title: InfluxDB Internal - System Snapshot
